windows.name: Notes on splitting a bill
windows.description: A short page with a small calculator in it.

steps.name: Split
steps.sentence: Work out the tip, the total and each share from @Bill, @Tip and @People.

page.text: Restaurants differ, but the sum is always the same. Enter what the bill says, choose the tip and how many of you share it.

A tip of 10 % is common in many countries; 15 % in others.
Round up the share, not the tip.
Split unevenly? Run it again with the smaller group.
